description: This file defines the CloudWatchLogsClient class for interacting with the Amazon CloudWatch Logs service via AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for managing log groups, streams, and streams for streaming logs, as well as a helper for processing live tail log results.

classes.name: CloudWatchLogsClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS CloudWatch Logs, supporting operations such as creating and deleting log groups, log streams, and streaming log data.

methods.name: addStreamingFlagMiddleware
methods.description: Adds a middleware to handle streaming command flags in the request pipeline.

methods.name: getStreamingFlagMiddleware
methods.description: Returns a middleware function that sets the '@http' stream flag on commands designated for streaming.

methods.name: startLiveTailCheckingForResults
methods.description: Initiates a live tail log operation and processes the stream by yielding chunks containing session updates or results.
